headline: Kiteworks urges shutdown over cyberattack threat, then patches flaw
summary: Kiteworks asked customers worldwide to temporarily shut down servers after receiving a threat warning described as either a credible law-enforcement tip or a potential zero-day attack risk. Days later, the company said it had patched the underlying critical vulnerability and restored customer systems.
